title: Galveston Boat Club

services.name: Sailing Program
services.desc: Program MissionLearn the art, science, and joy of sailing from patient, encouraging professionals. The class focuses on having fun while learning the basics of sailing, rigging & launching a dinghy. Skills taught including identifying wind direction, sailing a straight course, tacking and gybing around a buoy, recovery from capsizing, and general boater safety. Students will learn to tie knots, identify parts of a boat, points of sail, sail trim, and simple navigation. In addition, they will learn to assist others, develop teambuilding skills, boost their self-confidence, and learn to treat their equipment and piers with respect. On bad weather days, the students will focus on water safety,
